title: TheOpenTranscribe Job (v1)
description: A transcription job document exchanged between the future web application and runner.

schema_version.description: Contract version this document conforms to. Bump only on breaking changes; add a new job.vN.schema.json alongside this one.

job_id.description: A UUID (any RFC 9562 version, including the time-ordered UUIDv7) identifying the job. Not locked to a specific version so any conformant generator (Python, TypeScript, etc.) may produce it.

media_path.description: Path to the source media file, relative to DATA_DIR. No leading '/' and no '..' segments.

language.description: Language hint forwarded to the transcription provider as-is (e.g. an ISO 639-1 code such as 'sv' or 'en'). Not restricted by this contract to a fixed set. Omit for automatic language detection.

result.description: Present only when status is COMPLETED; null otherwise.

output_path.description: Path to the produced .txt transcript, relative to DATA_DIR. No leading '/' and no '..' segments.

error.description: Present only when status is FAILED; null otherwise.
